question: What can change a stablecoin at the issuer, reserve, wallet and checkout?
answer: Issuer approval, reserve custody, account control, lawful orders and platform eligibility act on different legal persons. These dated examples show which object changes and which customer-facing service might stay familiar. Their July 2026 legal reading is historical; use the GENIUS timeline for the later rule state.

items.title: GENIUS timeline and current rule reading
items.text: The dated examples below are historical. Follow the current timeline for the October 21 OCC final-rule state and separate effective/opening clocks.

sections.title: Complete records

groups.label: GENIUS control plane: twenty legal events that can change a coin
groups.note: A stablecoin can keep the same ticker, wallet and payment terminal while its issuer, its reserve holder or its permission to be sold in the U.S. changes. Each card names who holds the legal power, what that party can change and what event lets it act.
